title: Family visit
text: We spent a wonderful morning in the company of M.Paz. Extensive knowledge of art history and very well connected with respect to the historical context. She is a very approachable person and willing to clarify any questions that may arise. We will repeat with her on more visits.

title: Has a Large Communication Capacity (in covers)
text:
We are a group of 9 alumni who regularly carry out cultural activities. 
Our guide (Mari Paz) is very pleasant and knows everything related to the Monastery. He has attended us splendidly and the visit has been a success for all of us. 
   He also left us some audio equipment that has allowed us to follow his explanations in great comfort.
